solution:
"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/add-digits/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

258. Add Digits

Given an integer num, repeatedly add all its digits until the result has only one digit, and return it.

Example 1:

Input: num = 38
Output: 2
Explanation: The process is
38 --> 3 + 8 --> 11
11 --> 1 + 1 --> 2
Since 2 has only one digit, return it.

Example 2:

Input: num = 0
Output: 0

Constraints:

    0 <= num <= 2^31 - 1

Follow up:
Could you do it without any loop/recursion in O(1) runtime?
"""


class Solution:
    def addDigits(self, num: int) -> int:
        if num == 0:
            return 0
        return 1 + (num - 1) % 9


sol = Solution()

print(sol.addDigits(38))  # 2

assert sol.addDigits(38) == 2
assert sol.addDigits(0) == 0

assert sol.addDigits(9) == 9
assert sol.addDigits(10) == 1
assert sol.addDigits(99) == 9
assert sol.addDigits(123456789) == 9
assert sol.addDigits(1) == 1
assert sol.addDigits(2**31 - 1) == 1
assert sol.addDigits(111111111) == 9
assert sol.addDigits(999999999) == 9
assert sol.addDigits(1000000000) == 1
assert sol.addDigits(444444444) == 9
assert sol.addDigits(18) == 9
assert sol.addDigits(27) == 9
